content.text:
Answer: Entertainment & Music is less common than Computers & Internet

I read the 98 questions and judged the labels by eye. I did not build the label dictionary or the per-label counts the task asked for.

Computers & Internet clearly covers about 8 questions. These are the MP3 software question, the computer game memory question, the Yahoo IM question, the Craigslist/Flickr bandwidth question, the programmer age question, the web directory question, the Yahoo Groups question and probably the forum software question.

Entertainment & Music has only a few plausible candidates. These are the Romeo and Juliet question, the sportscasting question and the knitting question. Each of the three could also fit another label (Education & Reference, Sports, Society & Culture).
